per_question.question: What is the mandatory notice requirement before an agency bank recovers excess pension payments from a pensioner?
Under what condition can an agency bank continue an either or survivor pension account after the death of a pensioner?
What rate of compensation is an agency bank required to pay to a pensioner for delay in credit of pension beyond the due date?
Which circular dated 30.08.2002 regarding the Single Window System for pension reimbursement was repealed by the Master Direction?
What is the circular number and date for the repealed instruction on recording of PPO numbers in the passbook of pensioners?
What is the circular reference number of the repealed instruction dated 14.10.2009 for pension withdrawal facilities through public sector banks?
How should agency banks facilitate pension withdrawal when an elderly pensioner is physically incapacitated and unable to sign or provide thumb impressions?
What recovery procedure must an agency bank follow when pension overpayment occurs due to its own bank-attributed operational errors?
What undertaking is obtained from pensioners regarding future refund of excess pension credited to their accounts?
What is the minimum threshold of banking outlets for a commercial bank to fall under the mandatory Internal Ombudsman framework?
What rank must an officer hold to be eligible for appointment as an Internal Ombudsman in a commercial bank?
Within how many working days must a commercial bank inform the Reserve Bank of India of a sudden vacancy in the office of the Internal Ombudsman?
Is the office of the Internal Ombudsman permitted to handle customer grievances received directly from members of the public?
What software architecture must a bank put in place to manage grievance records and provide case access to the Internal Ombudsman?
In the quarterly reporting format Annexure, what metric is reported under item 19 regarding bank decisions on IO recommendations?
What specific information is captured in serial number 20 of the Internal Ombudsman quarterly reporting schedule?
Under the revised SEBI KYC circular for non-residents, is a foreign client required to be physically in India during account opening?
What anti-spoofing feature must Video In-Person Verification (VIPV) infrastructure possess to confirm that interactions are live and not pre-recorded?
Which entity bears ultimate regulatory responsibility for KYC compliance when relying on records obtained from CKYCRR?
What alternative document is permissible for address verification if an officially valid document of a foreign national lacks residential address details?
Which earlier SEBI circular dated August 22, 2011 regarding trading account opening processes is superseded by the 2026 KYC circular?
Which authority retains the sole discretion for accrediting an agency bank to conduct specific Central or State Government business?
In Annex 1 of the agency bank directions, which agency bank is listed under serial number 2?
What professional audit certificate must be furnished by an agency bank in Annex 2B to claim agency commission for Government transactions?
How does the Reserve Bank treat Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) on GST when disbursing agency commission payments to accredited banks?
